items.text: Official or co-official languages here: Gujarati, Marathi.

languages.notes: Signals until the place's own language law and census are read.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Observe decency in dress; nudity on beaches and in public places is forbidden and punishable by law. Drinking alcohol in public places, gardens and on beaches is not permitted. Don't drive after drinking, and don't use air or multi-tone horns.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Respect local tradition and customs at religious places. Check whether photography or filming is allowed at each place before using a camera.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Department of Tourism, Daman and Diu (now part of the merged union territory).
culture-and-protocol.note: From the Daman and Diu tourism citizen's charter, written before the 2020 merger with Dadra and Nagar Haveli; it covers Daman and Diu only.
